---
title: "Collaborating on Overleaf"
---

One of the key features of Overleaf is its support for real-time collaboration. Here's how you can collaborate with others on a document:

* Share Project: Click on the "Share" button to invite collaborators via email. You can specify their permissions (Editor, Reviewer, or Viewer) and work together in real-time on the same document.
* Version History: Overleaf keeps track of changes made to your document, allowing you to revert to previous versions if needed. You can access the version history from the History button at the top right.
* Chat and Comments: Communicate with collaborators using the built-in chat feature or leave comments on specific parts of the document to discuss changes or provide feedback.
